scenes.title: A wish arrives
scenes.viewerPurpose: Picture wealth arriving when someone wants change Enter four stories of deeply personal wishes
scenes.composition: An ordinary commuter notices an unexpected bank balance
addOrChange: Replace the opening platform crisis with a phone balance, withholding who caused it.

cues.narration: A banking error brings extraordinary wealth just when an ordinary man most wants life to change.
cues.visualAction: The balance changes and the commuter checks it again.

cues.narration: The Wish Series follows four stories about worlds that seem to answer private desires.
cues.visualAction: Reveal four distinct story openings without resolving their worlds.

scenes.title: Before the windfall
scenes.viewerPurpose: Recognize the desires driving different people Feel opportunities becoming almost too well suited
scenes.composition: Four people meet differently appealing opportunities
addOrChange: Replace repeated train action with a secure home, public role and considered offer.

cues.narration: Ethan wants success; others want plenty, influence, or the feeling that they are being reasonable.
cues.visualAction: Give each person one concrete opportunity matching the named desire.

cues.narration: Their opportunities feel personal in ways that are both tempting and difficult to explain.
cues.visualAction: Hold a small unexplained timing detail beside the attractive offer.

scenes.title: Four different temptations
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice an ordinary choice inside the strange setup Care about relationships and small refusals
scenes.composition: A platform decision leads into ordinary interpersonal refusals
addOrChange: Bring station assets here and keep the fallen person non-graphic.

cues.narration: The stories begin with recognizable choices, including a man left on a railway platform.
cues.visualAction: The train remains available while someone on the platform needs attention.

cues.narration: Relationships and small refusals make the strangeness matter.
cues.visualAction: Show a person declining an offer and another hearing the refusal.

scenes.title: The unchosen person
scenes.viewerPurpose: Allow yourself to feel each offer before judging it Ask how hard you would question a world that pleased you
scenes.composition: An inviting doorway leaves a personal offer unanswered
addOrChange: Remove simulation controls and later identity reveals.

cues.narration: Each reality invites you to feel the attraction before deciding what troubles you.
cues.visualAction: Keep the offer welcoming with its odd detail still visible.

cues.narration: How much would you question a world that finally seemed to understand what you wanted?
cues.visualAction: Hold at the threshold before acceptance or refusal.
